paper.title_en: Central charges as black-hole hair in weakly coupled trace-anomaly gravity
paper.abstract_en: We study black holes in Gabadadze's weakly coupled effective theory of the gravitational trace anomaly, keeping both the Euler and the Weyl central charges. We prove that a constant anomalyon on any Ricci-flat geometry, the Kerr family included, solves the full theory if and only if the two central charges coincide. Otherwise, the black holes continuously connected to this branch carry scalar hair whose charge is fixed by the surface gravity, the horizon topology and the difference of central charges alone: maximally supersymmetric matter leaves black holes bald, the Standard Model and photon-dominated sectors produce hair of definite sign, and conformal collider bounds confine it to a universal window. Electric charge separates the two anomaly invariants: the hair reverses sign at a critical charge-to-mass ratio set by the ratio of central charges, its extremal value retains only the Weyl charge, and the Euler charge governs the near-horizon growth of the anomalyon. For every unitary matter sector, the hair regular at the event horizon diverges at the Cauchy horizon. Finally, once the higher-derivative Weyl operator is order-reduced, the background, the anomalyon-graviton mixing and all propagation speeds depend only on the difference of central charges, which extends the no-ghost and Laplacian stability conditions to the full anomaly.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究Gabadadze弱耦合迹反常有效引力理论中的黑洞，涉及Euler与Weyl中心荷、anomalyon标量毛发、极值与柯西视界行为以及高阶Weyl算符约化后的稳定性条件，理论深度较高且给出了可检验的解析结论；归入引力理论基础，并因有效理论修正而兼及修改引力。新论文零引用按中性处理，未降低评分。
decision.title_zh: 弱耦合迹反常引力中作为黑洞毛的中心荷
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究Gabadadze弱耦合引力迹反常有效理论中的黑洞，同时保留Euler中心荷与Weyl中心荷。我们证明：在任意Ricci平坦几何（包括Kerr族）上，常数anomalyon解出完整理论当且仅当两个中心荷相等。否则，与该分支连续相连的黑洞携带标量毛，其荷仅由表面重力、视界拓扑以及中心荷之差决定：极大超对称物质使黑洞无毛，标准模型和光子主导的扇区产生确定符号的毛，而共形对撞机界将其限制在一个普适窗口内。电荷将两个反常不变量区分开：毛在由中心荷之比设定的临界荷质比处改变符号，其极值只保留Weyl荷，而Euler荷支配anomalyon在视界附近的增长。对每一个幺正物质扇区，在事件视界处正则的毛在柯西视界处发散。最后，一旦高阶Weyl算符被降阶，背景、anomalyon-引力子混合以及所有传播速度都只依赖于中心荷之差，这将对无鬼和Laplacian稳定性的条件推广到完整的反常。
